full_prompt_en: A square folk-art painting on a worn tan surface shows two simplified people meeting at the center of an open, shallow landscape. A dark-dressed figure on the left wears a wide triangular skirt that fans outward as one arm reaches toward the other person. The figure on the right has a pale gray body, a dark rectangular head or hat, and one leg stretched behind in a lively stride. Their hands join above a muted green oval patch on the ground, making the small contact point the center of the action. Across the lower foreground, a long black dog-like animal runs toward the right, its pointed ears, red eye, and angular legs reduced to a direct silhouette. Smaller people sit or crouch in the surrounding field: one red-clad figure at the left middle distance, one dark seated figure at the far right, and a few low forms near the bottom corners. Three almost identical round-topped trees line the upper edge, their blackish textured crowns and simple trunks making a flat backdrop rather than deep woodland. The ground is a pale beige wash with scratchy marks and faded patches, and the upper sky carries a soft dusty pink tone. The figures are made from broad flat color shapes and thin, irregular outlines; faces are minimal or absent. Light is essentially even across the painted surface, with no modeled shadows beyond small dark marks at the feet. The composition reads like a remembered event or simple visual story, spacious despite several small actors. Its overall effect is playful and slightly mysterious, held together by a black, gray, muted red, and sand-colored palette on aged paperlike texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅画在磨旧米褐色表面上的方形民间艺术绘画中，两个简化人物在开阔而浅的风景中央相遇。左边深衣人物穿向外展开的宽三角裙，一只手伸向另一人。右边人物有浅灰色身体、深色矩形头部或帽子，一条腿向后伸出，呈活泼迈步姿态。他们在地上一块低饱和绿色椭圆上方牵手，让小小接触点成为动作中心。下方前景，一只长形黑狗般动物朝右奔跑，尖耳、红眼和折角四肢被简化为直接剪影。周围田地里还有更小的坐姿或蹲姿人物：左中景一位红衣人物，最右一位深色坐影，下方角落附近另有几个低矮形状。三棵几乎相同的圆冠树排在上缘，近黑的有纹树冠和简朴树干成为平面背景，而非深林。地面是浅米色洗染，带划痕与褪色斑块，上方天空有柔软尘粉色。人物由宽阔平涂色块和细而不规则的轮廓构成，面孔极少细节或完全没有。光线在绘画表面基本均匀，除了脚边小暗痕，几乎没有塑形投影。构图像一件被记住的小事或简单视觉故事，即使有数个小角色仍然疏朗。整体效果俏皮又略神秘，以旧纸肌理上的黑、灰、低饱和红与沙色维系。
style_prompt_en: The image has rough folk-art painting on an aged, fibrous ground, with flat silhouettes and a deliberately uneven hand. Black, smoky gray, muted brick red, olive, and warm sand are placed in widely separated areas. Angular limbs and simple geometric bodies stay readable despite minimal detail, while scratched grain and rubbed pigment roughen the edges. Repeated rounded marks near one edge create a quiet rhythm above a broad open field; smaller scattered accents prevent complete symmetry. Light is largely flat and comes from the pale ground itself, with almost no conventional modeling. The overall effect is naive, graphic, and gently enigmatic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现绘在陈旧纤维底上的粗拙民间绘画，以平面剪影和有意不均匀的手工痕迹为特征。黑、烟灰、低饱和砖红、橄榄绿与暖沙色相隔较远地放置。折角四肢与简单几何体在极少细节下仍可读，划擦颗粒与磨损颜料让边缘粗粝。一边重复的圆形记号在宽阔空域上方建立安静节奏，散落的小点缀又避免完全对称。光基本平坦，像从浅色底本身发出，几乎没有传统明暗塑形。整体效果天真、图形化且温和神秘。
theme_en: Two simplified figures joining hands above a dark oval, with a black dog below
theme_zh: 两个简化人形在深色椭圆上方牵手，下面有一只黑狗
name: Bill Traylor
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
